test_title: PYST 24: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 8 3 5 8 4 7 3 3 4 9 9 1 8 5 4 9 2 6 4 7 2 5 1 2 1 4 6 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 8 3 5 8 4 7 3 3 4 9 9 1 8 5 4 9 2 6 4 7 2 5 1 2 1 4 6 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2cf770219be782bb3df57550ffef94552813a95a1393f6a6f66d045e651d280.png] 

Thus, there are 2 odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
